text: Mobile app development is an exciting field today. When building an app, developers must consider responsive design, so the app looks good on different screen sizes. They also choose between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one platform, like Android or iOS, while cross-platform tools let you create one app for both. After development, apps are usually published on app stores, such as Google Play or the App Store. Finally, performance matters a lot. Users expect apps to load quickly and run smoothly, so developers must test and improve their apps regularly.
